description: Discovery baseline on new manufacturers, with navigation and negative controls. This does not score extraction or robot replay.
provenance: Selected from first-party pages on 2026-10-01. The lead reviewed Jev-free browser screenshots, snapshots and raw state before any Jev evaluation. Manufacturers are absent from the existing finder and hub suites. Labels describe the captured main content, not search excerpts.

label.rationale: The article list contains individually identified fiber optics. Subcategory tiles and companion amplifiers must not replace it as the main list.
label.capture_note: The scout overwrote its first headless access-denial capture during a headed retry. Only the successful headed capture is retained.

label.rationale: The page describes the SPF series and lists exact variants with separate part numbers. Either listing or series-detail page kind is defensible, but the next action must extract the variants.
label.capture_note: The seed redirects to the recorded canonical path. Prices require login; public product identities do not.

label.rationale: The series description precedes a product-selection table of exact models and part numbers. Either listing or series-detail page kind is defensible, but those rows are products.
label.capture_note: The final scout capture still shows Data Usage Settings with Decline and Accept. Gate clearance is not established.

label.rationale: The portfolio groups miniature, standard cylindrical, factor-1, sturdy and hygienic sensors, with named AlphaProx families also present. These are groupings with selector links, not individual article rows.

This support page describes ONSeT, links to ONSeT Login and gives registration instructions. It contains no product list or embedded product-selection form. Document guides and navigation are not products.
label.capture_note: The observed ONSeT Login target is https://omronsolutions.com/. It was not visited and no account was created.

label.rationale: The selector contains named sensor models with exact article numbers and technical columns. Show more products is a loading control, not a product.

label.rationale: The main Products region lists individually identified sensors with distinct Type, ID and Details links. Filter options and the product-search sidebar are not the product list.
